'''Ridgepoint Tower''' is one of the [[scout tower]]s of the [[Stormwind Guard]] in [[Elwynn Forest]]. These towers are well defended against any enemies who encroach into [[Stormwind (faction)|human]] lands. Ridgepoint in particular serves as a watchpost against the advances of the gnolls and orcs from [[Redridge Mountains]], undead from [[Duskwood]], and the [[Defias]] from nearby camps.
